messages:
clare: noticed spike in small-gpu Pending -> evict in ap-south1 between 11:40-11:55 UTC. ~18 pods evicted.

matt: any provisioning or instance-type changes?

clare: infra autoscaler logs show new heterogeneous fleet mixed with older GPU flavors (A100s and older V100-like shapes). scheduler is binpacking by GPU count, but memory/capacity mismatch causing fragmentation. small pods end up scattered and get preempted by big requests.

sangeeta: that can happen when flavor heterogeneity + AZ skew + constrained warm pools combine. we should prefer like-for-like packing for tiny pods.

devon: snippet from scheduler trace:
```
bind pod small-job-34 -> node-a (A100, 16GB free)
later: node-a allocated medium-job (4GPU) -> eviction preempt small-job-34
```

opsbot: Alert created: INC-5466.

matt: short-term mitigation: add a placement preference: tiny-pod-prefer-homogeneous: true for ap-south1 canary pool and reduce cross-flavor backfill aggressiveness. Also warm a small dedicated A100 pool for tiny pods.

clare: I'll spin a 30-node A100 warm pool and update scheduler hints to prefer same-flavor nodes for pods requesting <0.25 GPU.

sangeeta: also add a metric for "tiny-pod flavor-mismatch rate" and set an alert if >5% of binds in 10m are to mixed-flavor nodes.

matt: mid-term: evaluate scheduler scoring to include a flavor-match bonus and consider a descheduler job that coalesces tiny pods onto homogeneous islands during low load windows.

clare: applying canary now to ap-south1a, creating pool and preference. will monitor 20m. :eyes:
